description:
Levi Strauss & Co. built an enterprise multi-agent software development lifecycle on GitHub Copilot's custom agents platform. In this GitHub Universe 2026 session, Jenny Patchen, Sr. Director at Levi Strauss & Co., reveals how seventeen specialized AI agents handle requirements, spec generation, automated testing, security scanning, accessibility validation, and deployment connected to Jira, Confluence, and New Relic through Model Context Protocol (MCP). Every pull request is reviewed by 5 to 11 independent agents that automatically fix issues and commit back to the branch, while retaining strict human approval gates. Explore the enterprise architecture, lessons learned, and practical blueprints for adopting a multi-agent SDLC across your organization.

Speaker:
Jenny Patchen, Sr. Director, Shared Platforms & Services, Levi Strauss & Co.

description:
Ever talked yourself out of starting a side project because you knew how much boilerplate code it would take? On the GitHub Podcast, Martin Woodward explains why developers need to give themselves permission to play and treat experiments as genuine learning. From running local models on a Raspberry Pi to tracking license plates in his driveway, see how GitHub Copilot helps restart hobby projects. Set a timebox, focus on getting something working, and ship it before perfectionism takes over.
